THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 04.03.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:18746 WP(C)No.8309 of 2025  3  JUDGMENT Dated this the 4th day of March, 2025 The prayer in the writ petition is for an early disposal of Ext.P4 arbitration application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.

In view of the limited prayer made, this writ petition is disposed of directing the 2 nd respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P4, after hearing the petitioner and the representative of the NHAI,
at the earliest at any rate, within eight months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
Sd/-
